critical_code_review_comments: Cookie consent banner overlay still renders even after localStorage.bidvex_cookie_consent={version:1,accepted:true} is set in an init_script. It did NOT block test interactions (modal opened, dropdown was reachable), but it's worth confirming the banner-suppression logic reads the same localStorage key/shape that the agent-to-agent note documents.

POST /api/twilio/contractor/create-client-account validates Pydantic body before the iter323 CONTRACTOR_CREATABLE_ACCOUNT_TYPES gate, so a payload that omits required fields like business_name/contact_name returns 400 from the global Pydantic exception handler — not 422. For the strict bilingual 422 envelope to surface, the caller MUST send a complete CreateClientAccountBody (business_name, contact_name, email, phone). Frontend already does this; just flagging for any API consumers.

Inbound Parse endpoint accepts the unknown/missing tag cases gracefully (returns {ok:true, matched:false}). The positive 'matched:true' path requires a real partners+c{contractor_id}@reply.bidvex.ca with the active contractor's id — verified by the parse_contractor_tag unit tests + the live partners+cNONEXISTENT9999 test confirming the negative path.
